attaches.why: Dario's shelf-line rule is a mechanic of the pantry restocking routine that the frame asks about: how restocking runs. It marks the one-third threshold on each shelf so the call is a glance, not a count. It sits in tension with the later reconciliation that moves oats and rice to half full, because a line at a third on every shelf no longer fits those two. That tension is left standing, not resolved.
